@copilot Align this PR's Couchbase error regression coverage with the repository's baseline-plus-version-specific test pattern. Keep this assignment scoped to existing PR #20704 and preserve its draft/ready state.

RequestSpan.recordException first appears in Couchbase Java SDK 3.3.4 through core-io 2.3.4, not SDK 3.6.0. It is present in https://github.com/couchbase/couchbase-jvm-clients/blob/java-client-3.3.4/core-io/src/main/java/com/couchbase/client/core/cnc/RequestSpan.java and absent in the 3.3.3 tag. First confirm that the existing real-SDK/server oversized-upsert regression produces the expected terminal ValueTooLargeException on SDK 3.3.4. If it does, rename version360Test to version334Test, move CouchbaseErrorsTest to src/version334Test, and use implementation("com.couchbase.client:java-client:${baseVersion("3.3.4").orLatest()}") inside that suite. This follows the existing Mongo version37Test and Reactor version34Test pattern and exercises the minimum relevant version in normal runs and the latest version in latest-dependency runs. If the actual oversized-upsert behavior requires a later SDK, retain the appropriate minimum suite/version and explain that concrete limitation instead of claiming the recordException API requires 3.6. Adapt test-only API usage to the selected minimum version where necessary.

Keep the baseline library dependency at 3.2.0 and baseline-compatible tests in src/test. Retain the existing testLatestDeps() conditional error.type expectations in CouchbaseClient32Test and the latest-dependencies guard in CouchbaseExceptionSignalTest. Do not upgrade the default runtime or remove baseline coverage.

Preserve both existing upsertOutcome parameter rows, the real Couchbase server, and exact emitted-telemetry assertions. Keep a separate Experimental execution for the version-specific suite, wired into check. error.type must be identical with otel.instrumentation.couchbase.emit-experimental-telemetry off and on; only the extra Couchbase attributes and internal spans depend on that flag. Preserve the production error-classification fix and exception event/log behavior. Do not reintroduce manually driven RequestSpan tests, add test permutations, or make unrelated changes.

Run the narrowest applicable spotlessApply before relevant validation. Verify the regression with the selected minimum SDK and latest dependencies, in default and experimental modes where feasible. Report any blocked validation explicitly. Update only stale or misleading PR metadata, preserving the repository template. Report the SDK version selected, what justified it, and the delivered changes.

The PR body still says SDK 3.6; the available PR metadata tool is read-only, so I could not update that text.

threads.body: [Testing] The small upsert succeeds without recording an exception, so it does not exercise this recovery guard. Removing the status check would still pass the added upsert assertions. Add a focused test through the agent-installed RequestTracer that records an exception, ends with a non-error status, and verifies that the exported span has no `error.type`. Include an ERROR-to-OK transition to protect the new status tracking.

replies.body: Added `recoveredExceptionDoesNotReportErrorType` in 16d3ab195b2f41d87416d90edcd61fc2106b64ff. It uses the agent-installed tracer from the existing cluster fixture and covers both a recorded exception ending with UNSET status and a recorded exception followed by ERROR then OK. Both cases assert the complete exported trace, the final status, the exception event, and absence of `error.type`. The tests live in `version334Test` because the baseline SDK 3.2.0 lacks `RequestSpan.recordException`.
